title: Telescoping log potential
statement: For any natural numbers $N,T$, any real learning rate $\eta$, and any loss sequence $\ell$ for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds, the successive changes in the logarithm of the potential sum to the total change: $\sum_{t\in\mathrm{Fin}\,T}\bigl(\log W_{t+1}-\log W_t\bigr)=\log W_T-\log W_0$, where $W_t$ is the sum of the Hedge weights at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a loss sequence for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds
replaced:
Let $\eta \in \bbr$ and let $\ell$ be a loss sequence for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds,
with potential $W_t = \texttt{potential}\ \eta\ \ell\ t$.  Then the one-step changes of the
log potential telescope:
\[
  \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} \bigl(\log W_{t+1} - \log W_t\bigr) \;=\; \log W_T - \log W_0 .
\]
